system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hi Spotify - if I already have Spotify Premium, does that mean I qualify to pay $99 for 2018? Or do I have to sign up all over again?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hi there! If you already have Spotify Premium, you may still be eligible for special offers. Check out more info here: <URL> Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "The offer is outdated (2018); reply should clarify current promotions and avoid confusion."}
